chars.HUSBAND: a 38-year-old man wearing a burgundy knit sweater, dark blue jeans and brown leather shoes
chars.WIFE: a 33-year-old woman wearing a mustard yellow long cardigan over a cream blouse, black trousers and a light beige headscarf
chars.NEIGHBOUR: a 27-year-old man wearing a light blue denim jacket over a black t-shirt, white sneakers and a silver wristwatch
chars.MOTHER: an older woman wearing a dark green djellaba and a white headscarf
chars.FATHER: an older man wearing a brown djellaba and a white knitted cap

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a modern Moroccan apartment living room, seen from the doorway: the WIFE and the NEIGHBOUR stand side by side, both pressing smartphones to their ears, calling nervously, worried faces turned to each other. Head-to-waist framing, faces clearly visible, subjects centered.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Morning in a simple Casablanca hotel room: the HUSBAND sits on the edge of the unmade bed holding his phone, staring at a long list of missed calls, tired and shocked, a small travel bag at his feet.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Traditional Moroccan salon with low sofas and patterned cushions: the HUSBAND sits with his MOTHER and FATHER, explaining with his hands; the MOTHER covers her mouth in shock, the FATHER frowns and puts a supportive hand on his shoulder.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The WIFE alone in a modern apartment bedroom at night, sitting on the bed with a baby crib behind her, typing desperately on her phone, teary eyes.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In his parents' Moroccan salon the HUSBAND looks coldly at his buzzing phone and turns it face down on the low wooden table, arms crossed, firm expression.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: The NEIGHBOUR lounges on a sofa in his own apartment, typing a message on his phone with a smug sly smile, one leg crossed.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Close view of the HUSBAND in the Moroccan salon reading a message on his phone, eyebrows raised in disbelief, mouth open, angry and amazed.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Daydream scene: the WIFE and the NEIGHBOUR sit relaxed on a sofa in a modern apartment, grinning and counting a fan of Moroccan dirham banknotes, feet up on a coffee table, lazy and cheeky.
